description: Week or day schedule on a time grid. Colour is identity, never state.

timeZone.description: IANA zone name. Required: a schedule rendered in the reader's zone is wrong by hours, not by style.

anchorDate.description: ISO date the view opens on. Defaults to today in `timeZone`; pass and change it to drive the date yourself.

view.description: Omit to derive from the CONTAINER width: day below --bp-md, else week.

dayStart.description: HH:MM the grid starts at. Defaults to the earliest visible event's hour, floored.

hideEmptyWeekend.description: Drop Sunday from the week unless an event falls on it.

eventClick.description: An event chip was activated; carries the event.

dateClick.description: A day header or column background was activated; carries the ISO date.

rangeChange.description: The anchor moved via prev/Today/next; carries the new ISO date. A date rather than a delta, because Today is not a delta.

actions.description: Right-aligned in the toolbar, beside the range title.
